name: mobile-app-config
description: Configure mobile app projects and convert Figma or text design tokens into Flutter design-system Dart files from agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Configure mobile apps and convert design tokens to Flutter
interface.longDescription: Deterministic mobile app setup workflows for Android product flavors, Firebase google-services.json files, package names, flavor-specific app names, generated assets, optional network security, and Figma or text design tokens to Flutter design-system Dart exports.
defaultPrompt: Use Mobile App Config to configure dev and prod Android flavors.
Use Mobile App Config to configure Firebase for Android flavors.
Use Mobile App Config to generate Android app assets.
Use Mobile App Config to configure dev-only network security.
Use Mobile App Config to convert Figma Variables JSON, Figma MCP variables, or plain text design tokens into Flutter design-system Dart files.
